old: The revised plan extends the work to V2 evaluation and a V3 edge-card design \cite{projectOctoberPlan}. It calls for a repeat of the reported \SI{85}{\watt} V2 operating point and an investigation of the \SI{15}{\watt} shortfall to the \SI{100}{\watt} target. V2 was subsequently operated with a modified resonant tank and reached \SI{137.1}{\watt} at the secondary output, with voltage droop and continued heating (\cref{sec:res-v2-testing}). Defined-duration thermal tests remain necessary. The plan also calls for fixed-PDO and PPS tests and thermal and stability runs of defined duration. A V2--V3 power-density comparison requires the same definition of assembly volume for both designs. Section~\ref{sec:revised-plan-criteria} gives the criteria and their current status.

Temperatures must be recorded over time on the tested assembly to check continuous output.

Internal winding temperatures and temperature over time on the assembled converter are needed to assess continuous operation.
reason: Replaces a list of what images cannot resolve with the measurements needed for continuous operation.
